title: Spec-first peer, test omissions, and HATCH writer acceptance
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source review and existing-gate refinement
scope: Recheck a separate ODA-spec-derived DWG parser and its declared maturity
Inspect ACadRust/OpenCADStudio codec lineage and whether missing-sample tests are skipped
Reconcile the closed OpenCADStudio HATCH/polyline recovery report with local HATCH and consumer gates
Use the closed OpenCADStudio Layout/MLeader/AcDs report as a scoped validation-design precedent

method.kind: Primary repository source, documentation, and issue review
method.limitations: Upstream main branches and issue pages are mutable and were reviewed as published on 2026-10-18. dwg-rs and ACadRust/OpenCADStudio statements are project-reported evidence, not independent normative format authority. OpenCADStudio issue #570 names LibreDWG but not its second strict reader and provides no hash-bound audit receipt; issue #1078 reports detailed maintainer validation but does not publish a reproducible native audit artifact. No peer runtime or external fixture was used. ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte layout.

sources.revision: Mutable main repository and documentation accessed 2026-10-18; no commit pin established in this review
sources.observed: The project declares a pre-alpha ODA v5.4.1-spec-led DWG reader, a raw object walker, per-record boundary checks, and version-specific decoded/skipped/error counts over a changing 19-file corpus. Its entity graph is partial; it has no DXF parser; its writer is experimental and lacks automated external-CAD acceptance. R14/R2007 output is absent. The project discloses a limited LZ77 algorithm-comment cross-check against ACadSharp.

sources.revision: Mutable repository pages accessed 2026-10-18; standalone manifest reports 0.6.5 while OpenCADStudio main pins its fork at a separate git revision
sources.observed: ACadRust identifies OpenCADStudio's opencadcodec as a fork in the same codec family. ACadRust reports broad DWG/DXF version support with explicit R12 fidelity/export caveats and says tests needing drawings absent from the repository are ignored by default. Its same-codec round-trip/generated controls are not independent semantic or external acceptance evidence.

sources.revision: Issue status and comments accessed 2026-10-18; issue closed on 2026-10-13
sources.observed: The issue reports a HATCH/closed-polyline DWG recovery failure with two errors fixed and two objects erased. The maintainer says a current-main R2018 output from the supplied drawing plus a line opened without errors in LibreDWG and an unnamed strict third-party reader. No second-reader identity/build, hash-bound output, full audit log, or semantic source/output identity map is given in the report.

sources.revision: Issue status and maintainer fix comment accessed 2026-10-18; issue closed
sources.observed: The maintainer reports correcting the R2013+ entity header and Layout serialization, then comparing 345 MLEADER records, 8 Layout records, and a byte-identical 613-segment AcDs section. This is a useful scoped validation precedent, but is not an independently reproducible native AUDIT artifact.

assessment.planImpact: Refines existing optional peer and composed HATCH/graph acceptance gates only. dwg-rs is eligible only as a pinned structural comparator for a specific question; ACadRust test receipts must surface ignored missing-drawing tests; OpenCADStudio issue #570 is a partially specified positive route report, not native qualification. Future compatibility evidence remains keyed by version, direction, identity/owner/reference disposition, reader identity/build, audit/deletion outcomes, and semantic result. Findings/subplans remain 133/76.
